summary: Assigns a MAT path at SOP level so geometry can carry a material assignment into rendering.

key_params.name: mat
key_params.note: Material path assigned to the SOP geometry.

common_gotchas: Object/Geometry COMP Material parameters override Material SOP assignments.
Use Material SOP for SOP-level assignment, not shader editing.
The MAT path must resolve in the component context where the geometry is rendered.
key_concepts: Material SOP assigns a MAT at SOP level.
The official page documents a single operator-specific parameter: `mat`.
A Geometry/Object COMP Material parameter overrides SOP-level material attributes.
Material SOP assigns materials; it does not edit MAT shader parameters.
